messages:
Kai Chen: Hey team — I pushed the requested small change to the sampler buffer (PR #3123). PTAL when you have a sec; I addressed the buffer-size comment and a couple of unit test flakiness fixes.

Jess Patel: Thanks. Quick Q — does this change affect peak memory during long sequences?

Kai Chen: Minimal. I changed sampler.buffer_size from 8 -> 4 for short sequences; added a guard in `sampler.rs` to avoid double-allocation. Example:
```
if peek_len < BUFFER_CAPACITY { reuse_buffer(); } else { alloc_temp(); }
```

Omar Ruiz: Tests look good locally. Could you add a tiny comment about why 4 was chosen? future-us will thank us.

Kai Chen: Added a one-liner comment and a unit asserting no growth for seq < 512.

Ryan Kim: Any perf numbers? If it's neutral, I'm fine with canary tomorrow during low traffic window.

Kai Chen: Ran the small perf bench: median latency +0.4% on microbench, p50 unchanged. Pushed bench output to the PR.

ci-bot: CI started for branch sampler-fix-3123 — build

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green ✅

Jess Patel: LGTM apart from a tiny inline nit (spacing) — very minor.

Omar Ruiz: Looks good to me too. Approving.

Ryan Kim: Approving, will queue merge after 09:30 PT canary window. Make sure the rollback tag is ready.

Kai Chen: Addressed the spacing nit and squashed commits into one. Can someone hit merge when the canary window opens? I'll watch logs and abort if anything odd pops up.

Jess Patel: Will merge at 09:31 PT and monitor. :eyes:

Ryan Kim: Noted. Thanks Kai.

Kai Chen: Thanks all — appreciate the quick rounds :tada:
